retouch.model: Not exposed by the built-in tool
retouch.scope: Removed printed graphics and lettering from apparel.
retouch.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the edit target: a licensed real overhead photograph of a group on a red running track. Remove only the printed shirt graphics, brand logos and lettering on the athletes' clothing and shoes, leaving plain fabric of the same color. Preserve everything else exactly: the same eight people, their bodies, faces, hair, poses, locations, realistic clothing folds and shadows; all long cast shadows; the red track, white lane markings, framing, landscape aspect ratio, colors and natural light. This is a minimal local logo-removal edit of a real photo for an app cover. Do not replace, add or remove any person or object. Do not restyle, beautify or recreate the scene. Return the same landscape photograph with plain unbranded apparel.
